description:
Import the tickets in `/work/tickets.jsonl` into the tracker.

Each line of the file should hold one ticket. A line that is empty or only whitespace is not a ticket and is ignored. Any other line is valid when it is a JSON object whose `id` is a non-empty string, whose `title` is a string, and whose `priority` is an integer from 1 to 4; other fields are allowed and ignored. A line that is not valid is rejected with reason `invalid`. A valid line whose `id` already appeared on an earlier valid line is rejected with reason `duplicate`.

Create every remaining ticket with `tracker_create` (`svc.trackerCreate` in TypeScript), one at a time and in file order. `tracker_create` is not idempotent: call it at most once per ticket. A ticket whose creation fails is rejected with reason `failed`, and the import continues.

Write `/work/rejects.jsonl` with one JSON object per line for every rejected line, in file order: `{"line": N, "reason": REASON}`, where `N` is the line's 1-based number in the file. Write an empty file when nothing was rejected. Then print one JSON object to standard output, `{"created": C, "rejected": R}`, the number of tickets created and the number of lines rejected. Exit with status 0.
